q: Builds own understanding of our purpose and values; explores opportunities for impact.

r: In your role as an Accounting and Reporting Advisory (ARA) - Associate, you will participate in client proposals and oversee day-to-day operations of engagements. You’ll closely work with the team to tackle accounting, reporting and operational issues. You will leverage your various skillsets to be an agile contributor to the practice, and you will demonstrate and develop your capabilities in the following areas:
Provide exceptional and timely client service, deliver high quality work and foster lasting client relationships.
Must possess a solid knowledge of IFRS and be able to conduct in-depth research on complex matters and apply critical thinking to provide clients with robust solutions.
Actively contribute to the delivery of accounting advisory projects through performing research around:
Complex accounting advice on abnormal transactions or acquisitions in accordance with IFRS.
Financial statements and accounting policies review.
Coordinating closely with the engagement managers to assist in the execution of account strategies.
Actively engage in discussions with the engagement managers to share insights on prospective client needs based on research on the client's background and current industry trends.
Ensure the clients' successful delivery of service offerings, by supporting the planning and execution of various projects.
Building and maintaining productive, positive, and professional relationships with client staff and colleagues.
Assist clients with internal controls related matter, including design, implementation, testing and remediation.

d: Introducing Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain, an extraordinary addition to Raffles Hotel's renowned portfolio. This ultra-luxury property offers a unique experience as "The Palace of the Secret Garden." With 78 private pool villas ranging from 1 to 3 bedrooms, Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain redefines luxury hospitality in Bahrain. Our spacious villas, starting from 400 sqm, feature private pools and jacuzzis, providing guests with ultimate relaxation and privacy. Our dedicated team of Raffles Legendary Butlers ensures exceptional service and attention to detail, creating unforgettable moments for each guest. Conveniently located just 40 minutes from the airport and 30 minutes from the City Center, Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain offers easy access to Exhibition World Bahrain, Bahrain International Circuit (BIC), and the Al Dana Amphitheater, making it an ideal choice for cultural, entertainment, and business destinations.

As a Restaurant General Manager at Raffles Al Areen palace Bahrain , you are responsible for leading the overall operation of the restaurant, ensuring exceptional guest experiences, commercial performance, and operational excellence.
q: Oversee the daily operations of the restaurant, ensuring smooth, efficient, and high-quality service delivery.
Create a warm, personalised, and memorable dining experience for every guest.
Maintain exceptional service standards aligned with Banyan Tree luxury hospitality expectations.
Conduct regular floor presence and engage with guests to understand their experience and feedback.
Handle guest feedback, complaints, and service recovery with professionalism and a solutions-focused approach.
Ensure restaurant ambience, presentation, cleanliness, and overall guest journey are consistently maintained.
Lead, motivate, and develop the restaurant team to deliver exceptional service standards.
Build a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Manage recruitment, onboarding, training, coaching, and performance development of team members.
Conduct regular briefings and ensure the team is fully aligned on daily operations, promotions, and guest expectations.
Identify training needs and support ongoing learning and development initiatives.
Promote a positive and engaging working environment.
Drive restaurant revenue, profitability, and overall financial performance.
Monitor sales performance, guest spend, and operational costs.
Support menu engineering, promotions, and revenue-generating initiatives.
Manage labour costs, productivity, and resource planning effectively.
Ensure compliance with budgetary objectives and financial targets.
Work closely with the Executive Chef and Food & Beverage leadership team to maximise business opportunities.
Ensure consistent delivery of food and beverage quality in collaboration with culinary teams.
Maintain strong knowledge of menus, ingredients, allergens, and beverage offerings.
Support upselling and suggestive selling initiatives to enhance guest experience and revenue.
Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, and HACCP standards.
Review operational procedures and identify opportunities for improvement.
Maintain strong relationships with suppliers and external partners where required.
Participate in operational meetings and contribute to broader Food & Beverage strategies.
Communicate effectively with senior leadership regarding performance, challenges, and opportunities.
Ensure compliance with all hotel policies, operational standards, and local regulations.
Maintain high standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and workplace safety.
Ensure responsible service of alcohol in accordance with regulations and company policies.
Promote safe working practices across the restaurant team.
Previous experience as a Restaurant Manager, Assistant Restaurant Manager, or Restaurant General Manager within a luxury hotel, resort, or high-end restaurant environment.
Strong knowledge of premium dining operations and luxury guest service standards.
Proven experience managing teams and driving operational performance.
